name: Suisenka
source:
Main character comes from a powerful family and thus has everything he wants. His colorless life gains new palette after meeting a girl who introduces him to the world of sensual pleasures. But one day mansion inhabitants rebel against such life and try to find their own happiness.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公出身于权势家族，因此拥有一切他想要的东西。在遇到一个将他引入感官愉悦世界的女孩后，他原本无色的生活增添了新的色彩。但有一天，宅邸中的人们对这种生活发起了反抗，试图寻找属于自己的幸福。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
